papers.title: Extracting Published Discussions of 13,616 Galaxies with Language Models
papers.comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Artificial Intelligence for Scientific Publications (WASP) 2026
papers.summary: Language model agents scan 156,006 arXiv astro-ph papers to extract 44,332 discussions and quotes for 13,616 galaxies, building GalaxyWiki.
papers.tldr: Using language model agents is used to identify galaxies discussed in more than two sentences across a corpus of 156,006 arXiv astro-ph papers and extract those discussions into GalaxyWiki, where users can find literature discussing galaxies, read what was said about them, and follow links to the source papers.
